plugin.name: YouTubeMusic
plugin.title: YouTube Music
plugin.desc: Browse, search, and stream YouTube Music to your Squeezebox players.
plugin.changes: The top-level "My Playlists" (playlists saved by hand in settings) is now "Saved Playlists" and only shows once one is saved, so it no longer looks like a second copy of My Library > My Playlists.
plugin.creator: schmij97, NikolajChristensen
